'''Kadavo''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Kadavo system/Legends|Kadavo system]] of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was under the control of the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]].

==Description==
[[File:KadavoLandscape-SotR.png|thumb|left|250px|The volcanic barren landscape of Kadavo.]]
Kadavo had a very thick smoggy [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that caused the [[Planet/Legends|world]] to look [[Color/Legends|purple]] from [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The particles in the atmosphere were caused by numerous volcanoes and [[Magma/Legends|lava]] pits, which covered a majority of the barren land masses and islands present on the planet. These volcanoes also assisted in creating huge spiraling cloud formations and other weather systems that could be seen from space.

The Zygerrian slavers built a [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|labor processing hub]] in one of the larger calderas of a super volcano on the planet. The hub was a tall cylindrical building where a large number of slave were kept while awaiting sale. It was kept aloft above a pool of lava by several powerful [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]]. It was also anchored in place by four cables attached to the sides of the caldera.

==History==
A [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colony that was abducted by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] in the [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] [[Kiros system/Legends|system]] was kept there for a time. After an unsuccessful rescue attempt, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Captain Rex were also sent to the planet.<ref name="Auction of a Million Souls">[[The Clone Wars 4|''The Clone Wars'' 4]]</ref> They eventually managed to [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|escape]] thanks to a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] intervention.
